definitions.explanation: A red fruit commonly used as a vegetable in cooking and salads.

examples.japanese: トマト⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦サラダ→サラダ：01364_sarada⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: To add tomato to a salad.

examples.japanese: ⟦トマトジュース→トマトジュース：noentry⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧。
⟦{完熟|かんじゅく}→完熟：27574_kanjuku⟧トマト⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{甘|あま}い→甘い：00617_amai⟧。

notes:
From English "tomato." Widely used in both Japanese and Western-style cooking in Japan.

TYPES:
- ⟦ミニトマト→ミニトマト：noentry⟧ / ⟦プチトマト→プチトマト：noentry⟧: cherry tomatoes (very popular in Japan)
- ⟦{完熟|かんじゅく}→完熟：27574_kanjuku⟧トマト: fully ripe tomato
- ⟦{青|あお}→青：02841_ao⟧トマト: green (unripe) tomato
- ⟦フルーツトマト→フルーツトマト：noentry⟧: fruit tomato (a sweet variety bred for eating raw)

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦トマトソース→トマトソース：noentry⟧: tomato sauce
- ⟦トマトジュース→トマトジュース：noentry⟧: tomato juice
- トマト⟦{缶|かん}→缶：01076_kan⟧: canned tomatoes
- ⟦{冷|ひ}やしトマト→冷やしトマト：noentry⟧: chilled tomato (a simple summer dish)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Tomatoes are one of the most popular vegetables in Japan. They are commonly eaten raw in salads and as a side dish, and are also used in ⟦{洋食|ようしょく}→洋食：13274_youshoku⟧ (Western-style cooking). Japanese tomatoes tend to be sweeter and less acidic than those in many other countries.
